SELECT tc.id, tc.card_name, tc.card_company, tc.bank_name, tc.instant_use, tc.applied_rate_info, tc.exchange_fee, tc.payment_fee, tc.auto_charge_supported, tc.is_transit_card AS transit_card, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_card_currencies tcc WHERE tcc.card_id = tc.id ) AS supported_currency_count FROM travel_cards tc
tc.is_active = TRUE
AND ( tc.card_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.card_company LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.bank_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_card_currencies filter_currency WHERE filter_currency.card_id = tc.id AND filter_currency.currency_code = #{currencyCode} )
AND tc.instant_use = #{instantUse}
AND tc.is_transit_card = #{transitCard}
ORDER BY tc.id ASC

SELECT tc.id, tc.card_name, tc.card_company, tc.bank_name, tc.required_account, tc.instant_use, tc.applied_rate_info, tc.exchange_fee, tc.re_exchange_fee, tc.payment_fee, tc.withdrawal_fee, tc.auto_charge_supported, tc.is_transit_card AS transit_card FROM travel_cards tc WHERE tc.id = #{cardId} AND tc.is_active = TRUE
SELECT currency_code FROM travel_card_currencies WHERE card_id = #{cardId} ORDER BY currency_code ASC
